limits: This is the complete original N Claude Desktop route using finite TEST SDK peers, not real Claude inference/authentication or native-provider qualification.
The exact original 75s poll checks expiry after a read that failed its predicate; a successful read returns first. No strict post-read wall-clock bound is inferred.
Embedded Runtime records/digests and source assertions are not independently archived copies of every Host storage file.
Eight original peer absences do not prove eight natural exits; the raw peer journal contains zero exit callbacks. Held standalone and Team inputs remain unknown without successful terminal records.

Launcher0/null, separately captured Host absence and passive original ChildProcess Host0/null are three different evidence roles; none is an atomic mapped-executable or original native HANDLE certificate.
Only the seven listed images were viewed. Screenshots and store/DOM/process observations are not atomic or continuous lifetime proof.
Current source attribution and a successful finite lane do not transfer qualification from M or to other Desktop/native/packaged/P09/static/release gates.

The reviewer only read existing files/Git objects, computed hashes, decoded JSON, checked ZIPs and viewed PNGs; no project/test/compiler/lint/provider/native/signal/source/ref/CI action was performed.
